Burrata Cheese & Roasted Heirloom Tomatoes.
Creamy burrata cheese, covered with roasted heirloom
tomatoes, basil and drizzled with balsamic fig glaze. Served

Crab cakes Maryland style, served on a bed of lemon caper

with melted provolone cheese, grilled onions, tomato,
spinach, and avocado spread. Served with fries …16

Strawberry Tiramisu. Layers of ladyfingers, cream cheese, whipped cream
